title: iPad Pro 13 Inch Cheapest Way and Month to Obtain One
body:
Hello Friends,
Wife's surface pro 7 finally died touch screen faulty. She wants an iPad pro 13 where it can double as a temporary laptop. Been digging around all I could find is the Optus iPad Pro 13 inch deal on oz bargain which is serving as a benchmark $2548.
Looking at past ozbargain posts July is the best time to snag a deal I assume it is during the crossover to the new models?
